##### Project general facts

Golf Hills 2 is a contemporary residential development that seamlessly combines elegant architecture with the tranquility of lush green surroundings and panoramic golf course views. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, the project is designed to create a refined living environment where modern design, natural beauty, and everyday comfort exist in perfect harmony. Spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and open-plan interiors fill each home with natural light while creating a seamless connection between indoor living spaces and the surrounding landscape.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, recreation, and relaxation. The development features an infinity-edge swimming pool, indoor and outdoor fitness centers, an 18-hole golf course, dedicated children's play areas, landscaped walking paths, and beautifully maintained green spaces. Every amenity has been carefully planned to encourage an active, balanced, and family-oriented lifestyle in a peaceful natural setting.

The residences are finished using high-quality materials that complement the project's contemporary architectural style and refined interiors. Elegant finishes, warm textures, and carefully selected details create sophisticated yet comfortable living spaces designed for modern lifestyles. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors according to their own vision.

##### Location description and benefits

Emaar South offers a range of residential options, including apartments, townhouses, and villas, catering to the diverse needs and preferences of residents. The architecture is often characterized by modern design and amenities. The community's strategic location near the Expo 2020 site and the Al Maktoum International Airport enhances its appeal for both residents and businesses. This proximity can be advantageous for those looking for convenient travel options and business opportunities.

Emaar South is designed with a focus on creating a harmonious living environment. This includes well-maintained green spaces, parks, and landscaped areas where residents can relax, play, and enjoy outdoor activities. Residents of Emaar South can typically access a variety of world-class amenities. These may include community centers, swimming pools, sports facilities, and fitness centers, contributing to a vibrant and active lifestyle.

The development may feature commercial areas with retail spaces, providing residents with shopping and dining options within the community itself. Given its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport and major road networks, residents of Emaar South may benefit from excellent transportation connectivity, making commuting within Dubai and beyond more convenient.
